title: Norwegian Beef Soup
description: A hearty and comforting beef soup inspired by Norwegian cuisine. Velvety texture and rich flavors make this dish perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: beef shin
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with good connective tissue for a rich broth

ingredients.name: velvety
ingredients.notes: Mayonnaise or sour cream work as substitutes

instructions: 1. In a large Dutch oven or pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
3. Add onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Add mushroom and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add beef broth, browned beef, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot.
6. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
7. Stir in velvety and let soup cool slightly.
8. Use an immersion blender to puree soup to desired consistency.
9. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
10. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
